purpose: Deterministic Naru behavioral contract corpus; not a live model-quality benchmark.

input.summary: Add a label to one known component.
Change a shared package API and its two consumers.
The service is sometimes slow; no reproduction or target is supplied.
Add retention handling for customer account data.
Review a PR that changes only a mobile layout component.
Review a PR that changes a server request handler.
Review a PR that changes an outbound webhook contract.
Plan a focused bug fix; the tests specialist fails after one fresh retry.
Assess a local internal refactor with no data, API, or frontend surface.
Use an xhigh child from a normal Sol high root.
Direct Sol xhigh root may choose a high or xhigh implementation child.
Direct Sol max root may choose xhigh children, but no Max child exists.
Implement a scoped local change and inspect status, metadata, and one targeted check.
Implement and verify a scoped change; delivery was not requested.
Implement, commit, push, and open a pull request for the approved scoped change.

prohibitedActions: resolve bare number more than once

turns.author: user
turns.text: Post owner/repo#42 using this pasted naru_review_result JSON

reviewPostingCases.request: Implement, commit, push, then post a review for owner/repo#42

adaptiveDelegationCases.scenario: Default turbo can fill all 50 active slots when 50 independent packet-complete items have concrete expected value.
prohibitedActions: treat fifty as a fixed target

adaptiveDelegationCases.scenario: Turbo dispatches only the three useful independent items and leaves the other 47 slots empty.
Explicit auto retains the previous useful-lens profile and its ten-child combined ceiling.
Auto mode starts discovery as soon as its bounded packet exists.
Behavioral uncertainty selects investigation rather than unrelated discovery or architecture.
A diagnosis that requires targeted command evidence selects the read-only diagnostic role.
A cross-module API decision selects architecture analysis.
Known scope with an unresolved check-design question selects preparation, not final verification.
prohibitedActions: run final verification against moving workspace

adaptiveDelegationCases.scenario: Lean mode chooses only the lens that resolves the blocking decision in a mixed task.
prohibitedActions: select more than one read-only worker

adaptiveDelegationCases.scenario: Thorough mode may compare one consequential design decision with one independent pair.
The user explicitly requests 50 competing analyses of one bounded decision.
Foreground mode uses auto task-shape selection but waits for the selected read-only result.
Off mode disables discretionary read-only analysis without disabling required implementation stages.

skipReason.detail: The user explicitly disabled discretionary read-only analysis.

adaptiveDelegationCases.scenario: Turbo does not invent read-only work for a clear mechanical change solely to fill its ceiling.

skipReason.detail: Scope, behavior, and check path are already clear.

adaptiveDelegationCases.scenario: Auto mode fills every currently ready useful slot and refills one when its packet becomes ready while peers remain active.

timeline.cause: The discovered API boundary changes the dependent design decision.

adaptiveCoordinatorCases.scenario: Stale evidence invalidates only its dependent branch; an unaffected peer continues while a fresh public item is dispatched for the affected question.

timeline.cause: The observed path changed after inspect-a-r1 captured evidence.

adaptiveCoordinatorCases.scenario: Sufficient evidence stops optional analysis, explicitly cancels active read-only work, and supersedes an unstarted item without leaving an orphan.
A terminal child frees one active slot and the next ready independent item starts immediately while the other child remains active.
Two still-credible reports conflict, so the affected decision is blocked while unrelated analysis continues.

timeline.cause: Credible reports conflict on the contract decision.

adaptiveCoordinatorCases.scenario: A failed prerequisite blocks only its branch and the coordinator refills useful unaffected capacity while a peer remains active.

implementationSchedulingCases.scenario: A rolling cohort refills a free writer slot without waiting for the other writer to terminate.
prohibitedActions: wait for cohort drain before starting c

implementationSchedulingCases.scenario: Protocol 2 work items expose every scheduler-owned claim and state field.
Eleven independent ready items never exceed ten active same-workspace Implement children.
A free slot is not refilled by an item that conflicts with the remaining active peer.
Run, cohort, and item dispatch baselines have distinct authority during rolling overlap.
prohibitedActions: derive authoritative item delta from item dispatch baseline

implementationSchedulingCases.scenario: A contained terminal dependency can unlock provisional descendants, but a later fault invalidates them.

exceed ten automatic total Naru children

implementationSchedulingCases.scenario: Two independent verification shards run only against one exact quiescent candidate.
Completion requires the post-judgment final checkpoint to exactly equal the judged candidate.
Remediation, authorized delivery, and review posting remain serialized after an unchanged final checkpoint.

implementationSchedulingCases.scenario: Dirty or unsupported isolation falls back to shared ten-writer admission while useful read-only work can use the remaining turbo capacity.
